verdicts.reason: In both, the rose is cut off by a hard vertical edge at about a third of the width, which looks broken. Both also leave a large dead white area at the bottom right and lose the original's centred vertical stack. In A, the 'When Life Is Great / PRAY' block is pushed almost to the right edge and drifts away from the divider, so the layout reads as scattered fragments. B groups the text more tightly, but it crams the divider right up against 'When Life Is Great' and keeps the staircase misalignment, so B is only slightly less disjointed.
